places.name: The Brow
ask: Its brow. Every god keeps a drawer of faces. Pick it one.
The brow first. A face. It came up without one.

places.name: The Heart
ask: The heart. What it's after. They're all after marrow, whatever they call it.
Over the heart, now. Something wants it back. Draw what.

places.name: The Left Hand
ask: Left hand. Something was in its hand when it came up out of the Red. Draw what.
The left hand. It's holding on to something. They always are.

places.name: The Right Hand
ask: Right hand. What it lets go of. Something always stays on the step with the rest.
The right hand opens. Old Scythe keeps a count; leave him something to count.

places.name: The Belly
ask: The belly. That's where the fear sits. It'll lie about this one; the card won't.
Down in the belly. Put the fear here, little hide, where it can be counted.

places.name: The Feet
ask: The feet. A road. It came up a stair out of a pool an hour ago. Give it a road anyway. A road's a kindness.
Feet. Pick it a road. It'll have walked it by mourning.

places.name: Under It, in the Red
ask: And one under it. Face down, in the Red. We don't read that one yet. ...Red. Read. Ha.
The last goes underneath, where the Red is. Leave it lying. It'll turn when it's ready.

weave.belly: Down in the belly, it's afraid of {p}.
weave.under: And under it, in the Red, face down till now: {p}. {w} wears that one.

open: There. Look at it lying there.
Well. That's the hide of it. ...And what's hid in it.

shapes.many_rev: Most of it lies the wrong way up. Good. So does everything here.
shapes.none_rev: Not one card turned against it. That's never happened. ...That's never good.
shapes.heart_belly: It's afraid of the very thing it wants. They always are.
shapes.hands: Both hands full of the same thing. It'll drop one.
shapes.calling: More {a} in it than it knows. It'll find out.
shapes.under_rev: And the one underneath is lying too.

close: Isn't it horrible? A moment ago it was nothing, and it was so quiet.
Up you get, then. The mouth's that way.
Go on. The sand's waiting. It always is.

mantles.one: the one who ends the turn
mantles.rev: the one who begins the next
mantles.say: Nothing on it. Good. It'll write itself in somebody else's hand.
mantles.say_rev: Turned over and still blank. That's the worst kind of full.

mantles.one: the one who walks and does not know why
mantles.say: The Pilgrim. Walking. Doesn't know where. Never stopped one yet.
mantles.say_rev: Stopped. Sat down by the road. They do that, near the end. Or the start.

mantles.one: the one who buries
mantles.rev: the one who digs them up
mantles.say: The Hands. It's buried more than it remembers. The hands remember.
mantles.say_rev: Digging the other way now. Up. Mind what comes up with it.

mantles.one: the one drawn to the light that burns it
mantles.wears: the moths with the white faces
mantles.say: The Singed Veil. Goes to every light that burns it. The moths have the right of it.
mantles.say_rev: Already burned. Not much left to be drawn to anything.

mantles.one: the one who is carried
mantles.rev: the knife that cut the cloth
mantles.wears: every child the Deep asks for
mantles.say: The Swaddling. Carried. Somebody's always carried, on the Hide. Somebody always carries.
mantles.say_rev: The knife that cut the cloth. Somebody had to.

mantles.one: the one who ends
mantles.rev: the one who keeps it under
mantles.say: The Gleaner. Old Scythe. Comes round once an age, and never misses one.
mantles.say_rev: The one who keeps the Gleaner under. Heavy work. Counted work.

mantles.one: the one who suffers to be believed
mantles.rev: the crowd that came to watch
mantles.say: The Weeping Saint. Suffers, so it's believed. Works every time.
mantles.say_rev: The crowd that came to watch her. Always a crowd. Never a face in it.

mantles.one: the one who reads until it is read
mantles.say: The Scholar's Eye. Reads until it's read. Careful what it reads here.
mantles.say_rev: The eyes in the Needle. Don't look back at them. ...It looked.

mantles.one: the one a breath behind
mantles.say: The Hanged Twin. A breath behind it, on the far side of every still water.
mantles.say_rev: A breath ahead. That one's worse. It knows where it's going.

mantles.one: the one that eats to keep
mantles.say: The Knot of Mouths. Eats to keep. Keeps to eat. Round it goes.
mantles.say_rev: The one that's eaten. Someone has to be the meal.

mantles.one: the one that burns down to give light
mantles.rev: the dark at the edge of the light
mantles.say: The Wick. Burns down for a little light. Every lantern's got one in it.
mantles.say_rev: The dark at the edge of the light. Always just there. Patient.

mantles.one: the one who cuts her hair
mantles.say: The Mourner. Cuts her hair for what the Red took. The Red's never short of hair.
mantles.say_rev: The one who's mourned. ...Somebody cut their hair for it already.

mantles.one: the one who locks the count
mantles.say: The Ossuary Key. Locks the count. Nine, and nine, and nine.
mantles.say_rev: The one who opens it. Somebody always does. That's why there's a key.

mantles.one: the one who asks at the door
mantles.say: The Beggar's Cup. Knocks at the door. Asks for marrow. Asks nicely.
mantles.say_rev: The house that answers. Don't answer.

mantles.one: the one who rings under the water
mantles.say: The Drowned Bell. Rings under the water. Only the drowned hear it, and they keep time.
mantles.say_rev: Rung in tune at last. That should frighten anybody.

mantles.one: the one who sells at the end of the world
mantles.say: The First Coin. Sold at the end of the world. Somebody's always selling.
mantles.say_rev: The one who buys. What did it buy? ...Don't tell me.

mantles.one: the one that hardens what is given to it
mantles.say: The Kiln. Hardens what's given it. Goes in soft. Doesn't come out soft.
mantles.say_rev: The one that cracks. Something always cracks in the firing.

mantles.one: the one who unpicks
mantles.say: The Unravelling Loom. Somebody's picking it out, thread by thread. Not me.
mantles.say_rev: The one who weaves it back. Badly. There'll be lumps.

mantles.one: the one who keeps what is lost
mantles.rev: the one who lets it go
mantles.say: The Lantern-Wright. Keeps what's lost. Nobody makes lanterns now. Nobody.
mantles.say_rev: Lets it go. The light goes out of the top, they say, like breath.

mantles.one: the one who holds the note
mantles.say: The Drowned Choir. Holds the note. Been holding it a long, long while.
mantles.say_rev: The rest between the notes. Listen. ...There. That.

mantles.one: the one who owes
mantles.rev: the one who comes to collect
mantles.say: The Tithe. Owes. Everyone left owes. A tenth of the hide, every time.
mantles.say_rev: The one who comes to collect. Knock, knock.

mantles.one: the one whose orders are never obeyed
mantles.rev: the city that would obey if it could
mantles.wears: the Man in the Rust, on the dark moon
mantles.say: The Hollow Crown. Gives orders nobody obeys. Up on the brown moon, still giving them.
mantles.say_rev: The city that would obey if it could. Can't. Never could.
